newsitem.title: CENTRAL AFRICAN REPUBLIC: Fresh Bangui clash kills four people, French hurt.
newsitem.headline: Fresh Bangui clash kills four people, French hurt.

text.p: Fresh fighting in the capital of the Central African Republic killed four civilians on Saturday and wounded more than 30, including French nationals hurt by a shell at their embassy, medical workers and diplomats said.

The Red Cross said the dead were killed by stray bullets or mortar shells during a second day of clashes between African peacekeepers and disaffected soldiers, who have yet to rejoin their units after three army mutinies in under a year.
Saturday's deaths took to at least eight the number of people killed during two days of clashes.
In Paris, France Info public radio said seven French citizens working for the French embassy in Bangui were injured by a mortar shell.
It said the mortar apparently came from a camp held by former army mutineers. It gave no more details and French foreign ministry officials were not immediately available for comment.
